The evidence instead reports competing accounts, including an analysis calling 孝 a later corruption and another arguing 孝 is unrelated to 爻. Replace with wording that explicitly attributes the corruption account and states that the relation is disputed (X-c591a16605448f5955ab, X-51d93845489b962c42f9, X-2cf609b1fd1963735227, X-4106dfb19b770b143df2). The same issue appears in `learner.components[1].text`: “One account treats visible 孝 as an altered form” should identify this as a proposed, disputed account rather than a supported alteration (same evidence IDs).
